newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-WITSCHGE RECALLED TO DUTCH SQUAD FOR SAN MARINO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WITSCHGE RECALLED TO DUTCH SQUAD FOR SAN MARINO.

text.p: Coach Guus Hiddink has called Ajax midfielder Richard Witschge back into Dutch squad for their home World Cup group seven qualifier against San Marino on Saturday.
Witschge, who has not played since the European championship in England last summer, replaces injured Feyenoord midfielder Jean-Paul van Gastel.

Otherwise the sqaud for the match in Amsterdam was largely unchanged from that which beat Belgium 3-0 in Brussels in December to maintain the Netherlands' 100 percent record after three group matches.
Goalkeepers - Edwin van der Sar (Ajax), Ed de Goey (Feyenoord)
Defenders - Frank de Boer (Ajax), Jaap Stam, Stan Valckx, Arthur Numan (all PSV Eindhoven), Michael Reiziger (AC Milan), Johan de Kock (Schalke 04)

Midfielders - Ronald de Boer, Richard Witschge (both Ajax), Giovanni van Bronckhorst (Feyenoord), Wim Jonk, Philip Cocu (both PSV Eindhoven), Clarence Seedorf (Real Madrid), Aron Winter (Internazionale)
Strikers - Patrick Kluivert, Marc Overmars (both Ajax), Dennis Bergkamp (Arsenal), Pierre van Hooydonk (Nottingham Forest)
